annotations.title: How an item, NPC, spell or quest connects to others

description: Every typed relation of one entity, both directions: dropped by, sold by, reward from, located in (player-observed, listed where 3 installs agree, with the install count and last seen), and created by, reagent for, part of set, same icon (found in game files, unconfirmed, with the build they came from). Ids are the game's own. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus and the committed client layer.

direction.description: from: what this entity points to (an item's sources). to: what points at it (what an NPC drops). Default both.

id.description: The game's id for it, such as item 19019.

kind.description: What the id names. A zone is a UiMap id, as on /map.

name: entity_relations

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

edges.description: Outgoing then incoming, grouped by relation, each group cut to the limit.

evidence.description: observed: players saw it, 3 installs. client: the game files, unconfirmed.

notShown.description: Edges beyond the limit, over every group.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: How an item, NPC, spell or quest connects to others
